info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Banking Accounts Verify-v4-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Verification API allows businesses to efficiently verify the creation of banking accounts. By leveraging this API, users can submit account details for verification, ensuring that only valid accounts are processed. Ideal for financial institutions and online banking services, it supports accurate account management and enhances compliance with regulatory standards. This API streamlines operations for organizations seeking to maintain high integrity in account-related activities.

post.summary: Verify an account using provided credentials.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to verify their account by submitting the required credentials. Upon successful verification, the user gains access to their account services.

requestBody.description: The request body for verifying an account. This should include the necessary credentials and verification details required by the system.

200.description: Verification successful; the account is valid.
